Subject: {{month}} notes from Fieldwise

{{nl_title}}

For most local businesses, the first thing a new customer sees isn’t the website. It’s the Google profile: photos, hours, reviews and a call button. Plenty of people call straight from there and never open the site.

So the profile deserves the same care as the homepage. Up-to-date photos, the right hours and replies to reviews tell people you’re open, active and worth choosing.

Three things to do this month

- Add ten new photos: Real ones: the place, the team, the work. Skip stock images.
- Reply to every review: Thank the good ones, and answer the bad ones calmly and briefly.
- Check your hours: Including holidays. Wrong hours are the quickest way to lose a customer.

What we shipped

- A resort in Indore: New website, online room booking, and event enquiries that go straight to WhatsApp.
- OffPay: 11,700+ people used it in its first eight weeks, and two in three found it through Google search.
